proposal.name: Retain component declarations and input provenance

plan.name: Retain component declarations and input provenance
plan.summary: Extend optional Go component checks with explicit target assumptions and inert, reproducible invocation declarations, preserving existing manifests and canonical selections; validate and retain separate snapshots of selected tests and drivers, assumption sources, every declared execution input and the nearest module files used to resolve identities. Keep production inventory and proof coverage separate, support assumption-only targets without granting evidence, and let explicit input references bind model files, includes and ratified locks for later comparison with caller-supplied execution snapshots. Deep-copy and canonically fingerprint the new declarations, associations and exact input bytes through the existing proof-attribution path, sorting sets while preserving argument order, checkout independence and existing volatile exclusions. Preserve legacy receipts, fingerprints and unverified lists, all existing acceptance contracts, ratified statements and locks, Go-only discovery, the refusal to execute explicit component checks and the model-only path; update SPEC.md and README.md to document the shipped schema, provenance and fingerprint inputs without claiming independent attribution or new receipt views, citing the supporting decisions on every changed SPEC bullet. The merger must record the new declaration and assumption policy and any needed journal roll-up because that policy is not yet recorded and this plumbing build cannot write decisions/.

tests.name: TestComponentProvenanceSeparatesSelectedDeclarations
tests.says: Selected tests and drivers retain canonical declaration snapshots, complete source hashes and nearest module provenance without entering production scope or discovering unrelated files.

tests.name: TestComponentDeclarationsAllowAssumptionOnlyTargets
tests.says: An explicitly declared assumption has a target-scoped stable identity, statement, reason and exact source snapshot, and is sufficient to configure a target without selecting an executable check.

tests.name: TestComponentDeclarationsRejectInvalidMetadata
tests.says: Loading and resolution reject unknown or duplicate selections, ambiguous declarations, duplicate assumption or invocation identities and inputs, and missing required declaration data.

tests.name: TestComponentDeclarationPathsStayInsideProject
tests.says: Assumption sources, invocation inputs and working directories obey clean project-relative regular-file or directory boundaries, rejecting aliases, escapes and symlinks.

tests.name: TestComponentDeclarationsAreCanonicalAndDetached
tests.says: Declaration and selection sets resolve identically after reordering or checkout relocation, preserve ordered arguments, and own their nested data independently of mutable manifest configuration.

tests.name: TestComponentProvenance257BindsEveryDeclaredInputByte
tests.says: Editing a selected driver, test, assumption source, fixture, model, include, ratified bounds, module file, dependency lockfile or configuration changes its exact byte snapshot and the proof report fingerprint.

tests.name: TestComponentProvenance257BindsDeclarationsAndOrderedInvocationData
tests.says: Fingerprints bind assumption identity and explanation, invocation identity and check association, command, ordered arguments, working directory, explicit environment, sampling and each invocation's input references.

tests.name: TestComponentProvenance257CanonicalOrderRelocationAndVolatileExclusions
tests.says: Resolution, attribution and fingerprinting canonicalize declaration and input sets without mutating callers, survive checkout relocation and preserve existing volatile metadata exclusions.

tests.name: TestComponentProvenance257OwnsAllMutableDeclarationsAndSnapshots
tests.says: Resolved inventory and attributed proof reports own all nested assumptions, invocation arguments and maps, selected declarations and file snapshots independently of mutable caller data.

tests.name: TestComponentProvenance257AssumptionsAndDriversNeverInheritProof
tests.says: Assumption-only targets and selected tests or drivers gain no proof; outside-scope declarations do not inflate coverage, and an independently scoped driver remains unchecked without its own proof result.

tests.name: TestComponentProvenance257InvocationMetadataRemainsInert
tests.says: Invocation text remains literal and executes nothing; Check and Run still return ErrComponents before tools start, RunModel remains available, and explicit Python and TypeScript configurations remain rejected.
